best_idea: NPC gossip is drawn from one pool where each source has a weight (quest rumours weigh a setting, ambient rumours weigh 1), picked in one pass, with each NPC giving at most one answer per talk session, so quest news reaches players without spamming them.
decision_why: Keep the weighted one-pass pick and the per-session cap; fix the expiry so quest rumours stay until their quest ends, because as read the weekly refresh would purge them (TalkManager.cs:2742, PlayerEntity.cs:462).
acceptance: A server test with one quest rumour (weight 50) and four ambient rumours (weight 1) draws 10,000 rumours and gets the quest rumour in about 93 percent of draws (50 of 54); a second talk to the same NPC in one session gives no second rumour; after a simulated week the quest rumour is still listed.
